635:t_011:2.en:
$$トライア$$
(No... The $$宇宙怪獣$$ didn't warp here on their own!)

635:t_011:3.en:
$$トライア$$
(The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and the $$宇宙怪獣$$ alike, by someone...!)

635:t_012:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's different from before! The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ clearly have the intent to attack!」

635:t_012:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Was the appearance of the $$宇宙怪獣$$ the trigger!?」

635:t_012:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ also have combat experience with the $$宇宙怪獣$$, and it is inferred that they are confusing us with them.」

635:t_012:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「We have to at least stop the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, or things will spiral out of control!」

635:t_012:7.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「What are you saying at a time like this!?」

635:t_012:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'm betting on $$刹那$$'s spirit until the very last moment!」

635:t_012:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「I've known him since the $$破界事変$$! I guarantee he's a man who always comes through when it counts!」

635:t_012:11.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That's right. In the fight against $$アレハンドロ$$, and in the fight against $$リボンズ$$, he was the one who settled it in the end.」

635:t_012:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「With the tough leader of $$大グレン団$$ saying that much, we've got no choice but to wait, huh.」

635:t_012:13.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Come on, $$刹那$$! Hurry it up!」

635:t_012:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Everyone is waiting for you!」

635:t_012:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you're an $$イノベイター$$, then carve out humanity's future!」

635:t_012:16.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$刹那$$! That is your role!」

635:t_013:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't sweat it! The real fight starts from here!」

635:t_013:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「However, you will work to make up for arriving late!」

635:t_013:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The situation is quite severe. Tell me what you're thinking.」

635:t_013:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「That giant $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ is something like a core. I'll make contact with it and share consciousness with all of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

635:t_013:7.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But then... that would be the same as last time...!」

635:t_014:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$ラファエルガンダム$$...! Is that you, $$ティエリア$$!?」

635:t_014:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'm late because I had to come from $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

635:t_014:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Y-You... I thought you were dead!?」

635:t_014:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「To me, as an $$イノベイド$$, a body is nothing more than a container.」

635:t_014:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But now, like all of you, I want to feel everything with my body.」

635:t_014:6.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Understood. Let's fight together, $$ティエリア$$.」

635:t_014:7.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Welcome back, $$アーデ$$! I love you!!」

635:t_014:9.en:
$$リンダ$$
「Well, well, how nice for you. You've got yourself a lovely boyfriend.」

635:t_014:11.en:
$$イアン$$
「This ain't a laughing matter for you either, $$刹那$$!」

635:t_014:12.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I'll handle monitoring the $$クアンタ$$.」

635:t_014:17.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Because his love is too big... Because I'm the one who's thinking of him... That's enough for me.」

635:t_014:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. I'm counting on you to look after the $$クアンタ$$.」

635:t_014:19.en:
$$フェルト$$
($$刹那$$, do your best...)

635:t_015:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Unless we stop the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$'s attack before we talk, there's nothing we can do.」

635:t_015:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「To keep on existing despite one's contradictions is to live... It's exactly as you said.」

635:t_015:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「But I'd like to avoid any unnecessary damage.」

635:t_015:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The optimal point of attack derived by $$ヴェーダ$$ is over there.」

635:t_016:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「So all we have to do is punch that spot and stop it, right!」

635:t_016:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't worry about it! Sometimes you can come to understand each other by trading punches!」

635:t_016:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Nice, I like that kind of thing!」

635:t_016:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah! If we're going to talk it out anyway, we'll do it our way!」

635:t_016:7.en:
$n
「We're not fighting out of hatred! If we pour our will to fight for what we protect into it...!」

635:t_016:8.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'll back you up, $$刹那$$.」

635:t_017:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll take on the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

635:t_018:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ダブルオークアンタ$$! $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$, carving the way!!」

635:t_019:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The giant $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$'s activity is showing signs of stagnation!」

635:t_019:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please wait a moment! The dimensional boundary line is warping again!」

635:t_020:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$!」

635:t_020:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Five cruiser-class! Compared to that giant $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...!」

635:t_020:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Wait, $$ノリコ$$! That space monster isn't just an ordinary cruiser-class!」

635:t_021:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Gravitational collapse is detected inside that space monster.」

635:t_021:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Are you saying it evolved by swallowing a black hole!?」
